// Configuration: Committed defaults only - environment-specific IDs and secrets are empty here. Later sources override earlier ones: this file < appsettings.{Environment}.json < user secrets (Development only; 'dotnet user-secrets set PowerBI:WorkspaceId <id>') < environment variables (deployed; e.g. PowerBI__WorkspaceId) < command line. See 'Configuration' in .github/copilot-instructions.md.

AzureAd.// TenantId: Optional for AzureCli/DeviceCode, required for ServicePrincipal/MasterUser. Set in user secrets or AzureAd__TenantId.
AzureAd.// XmlaAuthenticationMode: Auto (DeviceCode for AzureCli dev mode, else Shared) | Shared | DeviceCode. XMLA rejects Azure CLI tokens.
AzureAd.// XmlaClientId: Microsoft's well-known Analysis Services public client (same in every tenant), not an environment ID.

PowerBI.// WorkspaceId: Required: the only workspace the app embeds from and exports. Set in user secrets or PowerBI__WorkspaceId.
PowerBI.// ReportId: Optional: the report selected on first load (otherwise the first report in the workspace).

Export.// Notes: Exports stream one DAX query over XMLA. MaxRows 0 = unlimited; CommandTimeoutSeconds 0 = no timeout. EnableBenchmark exposes POST /export/bench (read-only perf baseline; infra/perf-export.ps1) - keep off in production.

MetadataCache.// Notes: Caches downloaded TOM metadata and (when report measures are used) report definitions so exports don't re-hit Fabric getDefinition. TtlMinutes <= 0 = never expire until restart/refresh. The disk cache survives restarts: delete DiskCacheDirectory (default %TEMP%/pbivisualexport-metadata-cache) after a deployment to force a reload. RefreshOnMissSeconds: re-download once, if older than this, when a field isn't found (<= 0 disables).
